name: 11417 · Ozone Park, NY
findings: ZIP 11417 (Ozone Park) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11417 (Ozone Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11417 (Ozone Park) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
